scope: Actual SDK SVC97 poll and legacy iterator; exact four priority ranges and 12 typed records, 500-byte request reset, error/disabled/empty-range handling, callback ordering/context/byte visibility, ignored returns, enabled-state mutation and saved registers/stack
limitations: SVC97 responses are deterministic hooks; this is not live SoftDevice event delivery.

Unknown observer bodies are intercepted; registry, QWR, GATT and advertising execute only in their named integration variants. QWR/GATT/advertising contexts are typed source records with product initialization gates; other contexts remain address anchors without full extent/initialization proof.
Empty ranges and callback mutations are controlled fixture changes; real concurrency, timing, observer lifetime, original instructions and full-image linking remain unproven.
